newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS share index down 3.0 pct, trend unclear.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS share index down 3.0 pct, trend unclear.

text.p: Some Russian shares recovered morning losses to end Tuesday slightly up on Monday but the RTS index of leading shares fell through the day and traders said the market was desperately looking for signals of future trends.

The Russian Trading System 22-share index dropped 3.0 percent to 489.92 from 504.55, its record close set on Monday, and market turnover was a strong $95.2 million despite the feeling among traders that liquidity was drying up.

"Volatility is very high and any aggressive movement will push it one way or another," said Raiffeisenbank equity trading head Sergei Sheikov. The index has gained about 20 percent since June 23 on new flows amid increasing nervousness.
National power company UES rose to $0.4687 from a daily low near $0.44 and $0.4610 at the previous close, Surgutneftegaz SNGS.RTS oil company rose to $1.18 from $1.15.
Long-distance carrier Rostelekom ticked up to $4.90 from $4.87. Some less liquid shares included in the index fell, such as oil firm Orenburgneft which closed at $7.20 after $7.27.

UFG trader Igor Vain said Western investors had reduced activity, leaving Russian brokers to determine market tone, and operators said it was still unclear whether long-term investors would resume a month-long buying spree, since new funds were still waiting to be invested.
